Spin decay alone implies a full transfer gap
routes.retired_because: Spin correlations do not control all transfer sectors; the manuscript explicitly excludes this inference.

C9000215.statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 215 (Canonical $`O(3)`$ continuum limit and exact $`O(4)`$ mass asymptotics.; papers: The canonical massive continuum limit of the two-dimensional O(3) model; An Isolated Particle Pole for the Two-Dimensional O(3) Spin Field; Exact mass asymptotics for the two-dimensional O(4) lattice model; Sharp mass bounds for the two-dimensional O(4) model; Exponential decay in two-dimensional classical O(n) models; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/215.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

C_ANNULAR_SIGNED.statement: Universal signed-coupling annular boundary-texture theorem with explicit harmonic-sum bound; independent review pending.

L_WARD_ALG.statement: Universal noncommuting gauge expansion, fourth-order cancellation, response signs, and eleven contraction kernels.

L_WARD_FORMAL_CORE.statement: Universal finite-family Gram contractions, complex wedge conjugations, parity cancellation, and eleven-error accounting.

L_WARD_FAMILY.statement: The finite-graph family inequality with K(beta)=6 beta^2+4 beta^(3/2)+beta, including signed strengths and arbitrary prescribed spins.

L_WARD_MODES.statement: Exact collective form, harmonic response gain, logarithmic HS and minimum-pair costs, and midpoint error uniformly over retained graphs.

G_ON_SPIN_DECAY.statement: Uniform free-boundary O(n), n>=3, spin two-point exponential decay for all finite beta and nonnegative bounded strengths.

L_SPIN_CLUSTER_TRANSFER.statement: Separate ferromagnetic pinning, crossing-to-decay, and higher-component reduction arguments; not certified by the Ward audit.

G_O3_CONTINUUM.statement: Canonical massive non-Gaussian O(3) continuum construction, thm:main and thm:canonical; outside this audit.

G_O3_POLE.statement: Isolated lowest spin-field mass atom, intro:main; also requires separate spectral and finite-volume estimates.

G_O4_SHARP_MASS.statement: Full transfer gap of order sqrt(beta) exp(-pi beta), thm:main; outside this audit.

G_O4_EXACT_MASS.statement: Full transfer-gap asymptotic constant 32 exp(pi/4-1/2), thm:main; also requires its exact matching argument.
